integrity: The standalone integer verifier exhaustively confirms the pointwise equalities, classification, and enumerators at seven even moduli through 16. This finite evidence does not replace the Fourier and Burnside proofs.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns only even moduli and the weights (1,1,m/2); the general weighted representation partition problem is not solved. Previously published general cyclotomic zero criteria can be specialized to this case; the explicit labeled and orbit enumerations are the quantitative contribution. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Exact complementary weighted-representation partitions for \((1,1,m/2)\), including translation orbits
